jobs.description:
Are you passionate about turning business challenges into impactful AI solutions? As our AI Business Partner, you will lead AI adoption within the business, identify opportunities, drive innovation, and translate business needs into tangible value through AI

About the job

As an AI Business Partner, you will act as the bridge between business strategy and AI execution. You will uncover high-value AI opportunities, develop and prioritize AI roadmaps, and lead initiatives from concept to scalable adoption. By embedding AI into core business processes, you will help deliver measurable improvements in performance and efficiency.

The role spans business partnering, change leadership, governance, and value realization, making it ideal for someone who excels driving cross-functional collaboration and translating ambition into business impact.

Your key responsibilities will include:

• 
Own and structure AI roadmaps, opportunity pipelines and business cases

• 
Play an active part in driving initiatives end-to-end from ideation and scoping through implementation, adoption and workflow embedding

• 
Ensure local adherence to AI governance, compliance requirements and approved ways of working, including risk reviews, exceptions and local signoffs

• 
Act as the primary link between business areas and the AI Office, escalating risks, decisions and prioritization needs when required

• 
Facilitate workshops, training, community sessions and demonstrations that accelerate adoption and continuous learning

• 
Track and communicate adoption, benefits and business impact, and help scale successful solutions across relevant teams

Who are you?

You combine strong business understanding with genuine curiosity about AI and emerging technology. You create structure in ambiguity, build trusted relationships, and take ownership for moving initiatives forward. We are not looking for a hands-on developer – instead, we are looking for someone who has a strong business acumen and is comfortable discussing AI-enabled workflows, low-code/no-code AI and automation possibilities, governance and value creation with both business and specialist stakeholders.

We expect that you:

• 
Have a relevant higher education in business, digital transformation, technology, innovation, or a related field

• 
Bring at least three years of relevant experience from business partnering, digital transformation, AI, portfolio management, consulting or cross-functional program delivery

• 
Have experience translating business priorities into concrete initiatives, business cases and implementation plans

• 
Possess strong stakeholder management, project management skills and communication skills across operational teams and senior stakeholders

• 
Understand AI opportunities and limitations and have sound judgement in a regulated, compliance-aware environment

• 
Are structured, proactive, collaborative and focused on outcomes and measurable impact

• 
Communicate proficiently in English

Who are we?

You will report to the Head of AI and be anchored in Orifarm’s AI Office while working closely with the business, acting as the key link between local priorities and Orifarm-wide AI standards. We collaborate closely with stakeholders across functions and countries to turn ideas into real solutions.

We foster a hands-on, curious, and experimental culture, where learning and iteration are part of everyday work. You will be joining a team where you are trusted to take ownership, contribute with ideas, and help shape how AI is used across Orifarm.

Why should you join Orifarm?

At Orifarm, we are united by a shared purpose: improving access to affordable medicine for the people who need it. Founded in Odense, Denmark in 1994 by Birgitte & Hans Bøgh-Sørensen, we have built our business on challenging conventional thinking to make affordable high-quality pharmaceuticals more accessible across Europe. Rather than developing new medicines, we focus on finding smarter ways to bring existing treatments to patients, creating value for pharmacies, healthcare systems, and society.

We live by the mindset Challenge Accepted. It reflects our explorer spirit and can-do attitude, where challenges are perceived as opportunities. We encourage people to ask questions, challenge assumptions, and take ownership. Across teams, functions, and markets, you will find a collaborative and supportive culture built on trust, respect, and a flat hierarchy where everyone has a voice and direct access to decision-makers.

When you join Orifarm, you will be empowered to make a real impact from day one. We offer autonomy and great opportunities for career advancement, enabling our employees to shape their professional development. We value flexibility and provide a hybrid work model with the possibility of working from home two days a week.

We invite you to join Orifarm, if you are curious, ambitious, and accept the challenge of bringing better deals of medicine to millions.

We encourage everyone to apply

At Orifarm, we welcome people from all backgrounds, recognizing that the best outcomes come from a diverse and inclusive work environment. Our commitment is to create an environment where different perspectives and skills drive innovation and contribute to a sustainable future. By creating such an environment, we are confident that we can achieve better results together.

jobs.description:
Do you want to be part of developing innovative and technical engineering solutions while further developing your professional skills? Then join us and become an intern at Eltronic A/S.

Eltronic A/S is one of Denmark's leading engineering companies within development, delivery, and servicing of automation- and production solutions for the manufacturing-, life science-, and food industries.

In our Ballerup division we primarily focus on automation projects within the Life Science industry. Our projects are characterized by the development of innovative customer-specific automation software solutions to meet our clients' individual desires and needs.

Part of the team

As an intern at Eltronic, you will have the opportunity to apply the knowledge you have gained during your studies to practical and relevant professional experience through our projects.

Your tasks and everyday work will be diverse, and you will contribute to our projects, where you will have the opportunity to make your mark on your tasks.

We will do our best to match your interests and competencies with real challenges and tasks. During your internship, you will be assigned a mentor, and we will ensure that you always have a skilled colleague available for sparing.

We imagine that you

• For our Automation team are studying Engineering, Technology Management and Marine Engineering (Maskinmester), Automation Engineering (Automationsteknolog), or other relevant education

• For our Manufacturing IT(MIT) team are studying software technology, software engineering, ICT engineering, electro engineer or other relevant education.

• Have a natural interest and flair for technical solutions while also having the desire to learn much more

• Are responsible, quality-conscious, thorough, and enjoy collaborating with others

• Might have a background as an electrician, prior experience with PLC-software and/or AVEVA-Software and/or SQL-databaser, or equivalent may be an advantage, although it is not required

We offer

An exciting internship and learning opportunity in one of our Automation or MIT departments, where your everyday life will be characterized by challenging and exciting tasks that you solve in collaboration with skilled and helpful colleagues.

As an intern, you will get your own desk, and you will become part of our strong community, which also includes other interns. You will also be a part of the social events that take place during your internship.

Eltronic A/S

Eltronic A/S is an engineering company with more than 25 years of experience in production systems, automation, and digitalization. We employ more than 250 engineers and technicians within a wide range of disciplines and with many different competencies.

Eltronic A/S is part of Eltronic Group - an engineering group that delivers intelligent special solutions in close contact with our customers, helping to increase their competitiveness and create a sustainable business.

Questions & Application

If you are one of our future interns, please apply as soon as possible.

Employment from January/February 2027, or by agreement.

If you have any questions, feel free to reach out to Automation Manager CPG, Stephan Nielsen at snin@eltronic.dk, Automation Manager Life Science, Sune Knutzen at sdkn@eltronic.dk, or MIT Manager, Naveed Yousaf at nayo@eltronic.dk.

We look forward to receiving your application and welcoming you as part of our amazing team!

jobs.occupation: Senior Financial Controller - Take ownership of business-critical financial topics
jobs.description:
Would you like to play a key role in driving high-quality financial control, governance, and technical accounting across an international Group – with flexibility in how you structure your work?

Working on complex and business-critical topics, including audits, IFRS, acquisitions, and financial reporting, you will influence processes, shape best practices, and strengthen governance frameworks and internal controls across the Group.

Join us and build your expertise in a leading international healthcare company dedicated to improving the lives of people with intimate healthcare needs worldwide.

Our Group Controlling and Reporting team is ready to welcome you

At our headquarters in Humlebæk, you will become part of the Group Controlling and Reporting team within Corporate Finance. Here, you will join a close-knit team of seven colleagues who support subsidiaries across the globe and are responsible for reviews, reporting, and controlling activities. We foster a friendly, inclusive, and professional environment with a high degree of flexibility, where collaboration is strong, new ideas are always welcomed and heard, and we make a point of having fun together when we come to work.

Be the key finance partner across the Group

As Senior Financial Controller, you will serve as a key finance partner across the Group, providing expertise within IFRS, technical accounting, financial controlling, and governance.

This entails acting as a subject matter expert on complex accounting areas and being the finance contact towards acquired entities. You will also be the one to strengthen internal controls and governance frameworks.

Specifically, you will:

•    Prepare accounting memorandums, supporting key accounting positions.

•    Act as contact towards external auditors and prepare audit documentation.

•    Own PPA preparation and follow-up in connection with acquisitions.

•    Perform monthly controlling of subsidiaries and key business areas.

•    Execute financial reviews and drive follow-up on identified risks.

•    Handle and prepare annual reports together with the team for both the Group and the parent company.

You combine strong financial expertise with a business-oriented mindset

In this role, you need to have the ability to navigate complex stakeholder environments, taking ownership of activities and projects as well as engaging and collaborating with stakeholders across functions and geographies. Also, your exceptional business insight and perceptive mindset enable you to effectively organise and prioritise tasks, while identifying practical solutions to complex challenges.

Finally, we imagine that you:

•    Hold an MSc in Business Administration and Auditing (cand.merc.aud.) or a Bachelor of Commerce (HD).

•    Have solid experience from a similar role, for example, as an auditor, financial controller, risk & control consultant, or operational control & compliance manager.

•    May have experience from an accountancy firm, though this is an advantage and not a prerequisite.

•    Possess a deep understanding of financial statements and accounting, including identifying issues and solutions.

•    Have strong knowledge of the technical aspects of IFRS.

•    Are fluent in English.

Interested?

If you would like to know more about this position, please contact Senior Director, Jesper S. Lauesen at dkjgh@coloplast.com

We continuously review applications, so we encourage you to apply as soon as possible. The position will remain open until a suitable candidate is found.

Pursuing an ambitious growth agenda, Coloplast develops and markets products and services that make life easier for people with intimate healthcare needs. Employing about 16.000 people and with products available in more than 143 countries, we are one of the world´s leading medical device companies. We are constantly growing our business and always looking for new ways to move forward – we explore, learn and look for new ways of doing things.

Coloplast is committed to being an inclusive organization, where people bring their differences to work each day, fulfil their potential and have a strong sense of belonging because – and not despite – of their differences. We therefore encourage all qualified candidates to apply regardless of gender, age, race, nationality, ethnicity, sexual orientation, religious belief or physical ability.

Watch the film. Follow us on LinkedIn.

jobs.occupation: Lead Consultant – Vulnerability Management; DK - Fredericia, Ballerup
jobs.description:
Can you translate complex technical security requirements into something the business understands and acts on - and challenge where necessary?

Energinet is seeking a highly skilled cyber security professional to join our Attack Surface Management team within the Group Cyber and Information Security unit. You will be the link between the department's technical specialists and the rest of Energinet and ensure that security requirements are both understood, prioritised and complied with.

You combine solid technical insight with clear communication and business understanding. You present innovative ideas with confidence, along with the presence and authority to guide decisions. 

Key Responsibilities

• Oversee the operation and continual improvement of enterprise vulnerability management capabilities across IT, cloud, and hybrid environments.
• Build, maintain, and optimize vulnerability scanning infrastructure, configurations, policies, and workflows.
• Develop scalable vulnerability assessment processes covering infrastructure, endpoints, servers, applications, cloud workloads, containers, and identities.
• Ensure accurate asset discovery, coverage validation, and vulnerability visibility across the enterprise.
• Manage lifecycle vulnerability processes from detection through validation, prioritization, remediation, and closure.
• Establish metrics and performance indicators to measure remediation effectiveness and risk reduction outcomes.
• Analyze attack paths, exposure chains, and security control weaknesses that could contribute to organizational risk.
• Develop risk-based methodologies for prioritizing exposures based on exploitability, business criticality, threat intelligence, and operational impact.
• Support continuous assessment of the organization's security posture through exposure analytics and attack surface monitoring.
• Serve as the technical owner and subject matter expert for vulnerability and exposure management platforms.

“We offer a job with a high level of professionalism and great societal significance, where you help protect Denmark's critical energy infrastructure. You will have skilled colleagues, good opportunities for professional development and flexibility in everyday life – in an organization that is growing and where cyber security is a high priority.” – Arpan Roy, Director, Attack Surface Management.

We expect you to

• Have a solid technical understanding in cyber and information security and can go in-depth with technical solutions.
• Have CISSP or an equivalent certification (e.g. CISM) - or are close to earning it.
• Is an effective communicator who can communicate complex requirements clearly to both technicians, project managers and management.
• Works in a structured way and projects professional authority.
• Have business understanding and the ability to question constructively and create progress.
• Be fluent in English at a high level in writing and speech. Danish proficiency is an advantage but not mandatory. 
About the department

At our office in Ballerup or Fredericia, you will be part of Attack Surface Management - a new department under the Group Cyber and Information Security unit. The department is responsible for the technical protection layers that reduce Energinet's attack surface. 

Together with the other departments in Cyber and Information Security, we are responsible for developing and operating the organizational processes and technologies within cyber and information security in Energinet and for coordinating the IT preparedness in the electricity, gas and hydrogen sectors. 

Want to know more?

If you have any questions about the job, you are very welcome to contact Arpan Roy at arroy@energinet.dk or on tel. +45 5161 2898. We review applications and conduct interviews on an ongoing basis, so please send us your motivated cv as soon as possible.

Special conditions: As Energinet performs tasks critical to society, we carry out background checks prior to employment. Employment is conditional upon your background check being compatible with employment at Energinet. The background check is also carried out once a year.

The position also requires that you are able to obtain and maintain security clearance. On PET's website, you can read more about security clearance.

We see diversity as a strength and encourage all qualified people, regardless of background, to apply for the job. We work actively and determinedly with diversity in Energinet and therefore encourage you to exclude information about age, marital status, etc. to minimise outage biases in the process. You can read more about our diversity policy here.

Energinet is an independent public company that reprecents society's interests when supplying Denmark with electricity and gas and that the energy system is converted to green energy. Our culture is closely linked to our social responsibility, and we work actively with the UN's global goals on sustainable energy, climate action, partnerships for action as well as industry, innovation, and infrastructure. By leading the way in the green transition, we can help to solve the global climate challenge. New solutions require us to be able to see problems from many different angles, and diversity is therefore a keyword in our culture. We strive to listen to, involve and share our knowledge. Based on the values of courage and trust, we focus on constantly developing ourselves as an organisation and as people. Read more at our website www.energinet.dk.

Do you thrive when the market moves fast, and decisions matter? Are you energised by volatile markets, quick decisions, and the challenge of turning live data into action? Do you want to build or deepen your trading experience while working directly with wind and solar assets?

As an Intraday Asset Trader, you will optimise NET’s asset portfolio in the live intraday power market. From day one, you will trade, assess risk and identify opportunities as market conditions, forecasts, and asset production change.

The team

You will join our Intraday Asset Trading team, responsible for the intraday optimisation of NET’s asset portfolio, with a particular focus on wind and solar assets.

The team monitors forecasts and live asset data as part of a 24/7 setup and works closely with colleagues across proprietary trading, automated trading, meteorology, and trading operations. We take a market-first approach and continuously look for ways to improve how we trade.

The role

Your focus will be to understand what is happening in the intraday power market and turn that information into trading and risk decisions. As NET’s asset footprint grows, continuous optimisation becomes increasingly important.

You will start trading from your first day. If you bring relevant experience, there may be scope to influence the area from the start. If you are newer to trading, you will learn quickly alongside skilled colleagues.

Key responsibilities

During your shifts, you will combine market information, weather forecasts, and live asset data to act on changing conditions.

• Trade and optimise NET’s wind and solar asset portfolio in the intraday power market.

• Monitor forecasts and live production data and assess their potential impact.

• Make fast, considered decisions while managing risk.

• Quantify weather developments and understand their impact on renewable production and positioning.

• Identify opportunities, execute them, and help turn successful approaches into more automated solutions.

• Collaborate with colleagues across trading, meteorology, and operations.

• Develop and test hypotheses, including through coding where relevant.

• Take part in shift rotation covering day, evening and weekend shifts.

Following a live intraday power market that reflects what is happening in the physical power system is one of the most exciting parts of this role. The market can be highly volatile, and you need to enjoy that volatility, act on opportunities and stay sharp as conditions change.

Anders Have Therkildsen

Head of Intraday Asset Trading

What we are looking for

You have a strong numerical mindset, enjoy making decisions, and are comfortable working in an environment where conditions can change quickly.

What matters to us:

• A genuine interest in fast-paced environments and continuous change.

• Strong numerical skills and the ability to assess information quickly.

• Confidence in making decisions and taking calculated risks.

• Curiosity and a strong motivation to keep learning.

• An entrepreneurial mindset and an interest in working in a growing area.

• The ability to manage several priorities at once and work comfortably in a shift-based setup.

• A background as a recent MSc graduate or experience within intraday trading; neither is a strict requirement.

Nice to have:

• Coding skills or an interest in using coding to test trading hypotheses.

What we offer

You will get hands-on exposure to intraday power trading, early responsibility and the opportunity to build your understanding of renewable assets and power markets alongside skilled colleagues.

• Trading responsibility from your first day.

• The opportunity to deepen your knowledge of intraday trading and power markets.

• Collaboration across several trading-related disciplines.

• Increasing responsibility as your experience grows.

• The possibility of helping shape the area over time.

• Shift rotation covering day, evening and weekend shifts.

• No night shifts, as these are covered from Singapore.

Interested?

If fast-moving markets, renewable assets and real trading responsibility sound like a combination you would enjoy, we would like to hear from you.

Want to know more?

Feel free to reach out if you have any questions about this opportunity

Anders Have Therkildsen

Head of Intraday Asset Trading

Vetaphone is the Danish company behind the invention of corona treatment back in 1951, and for more than seven decades the family-owned business has continued to set the standard within corona and plasma surface treatment technology. From its headquarters in Kolding, Vetaphone develops advanced, reliable systems that ensure optimal adhesion, print quality and production efficiency for customers in the print, packaging, converting and extrusion industries – and today the company is represented in more than 60 countries around the world. To strengthen the international sales organisation, we are now looking for a technically strong and commercially minded:

Technical and commercial sales support with close customer dialogue

As Technical Sales Manager, you become one of the key technical and commercial support behind Vetaphone’s global sales team, working closely with Area Sales Managers and agents to solve real production challenges where surface treatment performance impacts efficiency, quality and compliance. You get a broad and technically demanding role, where you guide projects from the very first customer dialogue and solution design through to quotation, negotiation and handover to the internal project department.

It is natural for you to drive technically complex, project-based sales to OEMs and end customers, and to step in as technical sales lead on selected projects in close cooperation with Area Sales Managers, agents and internal specialists. You analyse customer applications, production processes and requirements to define the optimal surface treatment solution, and you prepare and present technical and commercial proposals that communicate value, performance and compliance in a way customers understand and trust.

You support OEM customers with system integration, specification and application know-how, and build long-term customer relationships based on trust, expertise and results. At the same time, you contribute to knowledge sharing and capability building across the sales organisation and agent network, and you stay on top of market trends, customer needs and competitive developments – with regular international travel to customers, OEM partners and key industry events.

In the selection process, we will particularly emphasise:

• A solid technical background, preferably within mechanical and/or electrical engineering

• Proven experience with consultative, project-based B2B sales of technical systems or solutions

• The ability to translate complex technical concepts into clear customer value propositions

• A structured and self-driven approach, combined with strong stakeholder management skills

• Comfort working independently in an international, matrix-based organisation

• Fluent in Danish and excellent communication skills in English

• Willingness to travel internationally approx. 50-70 days per year

The ideal candidate has a solid technical foundation combined with a genuine sales flair, and thrives in a role where every project brings a new technical puzzle to solve. Maybe you already work in a similar technical sales role today, or you come from an engineering or application background and are ready to take the step into a more commercial, customer-facing career.

In return, you become part of a global technology leader with a strong market position, working closely with experienced technical and commercial colleagues on high-value international projects – with good opportunities for professional development within a specialised, knowledge-driven organisation.

The role is based at Vetaphone’s headquarters in Kolding, Denmark, combined with the international travel the role calls for.

Interested?

Sounds like the job for you? Then send your application and CV as soon as possible by using the “apply” function.

If you have any questions, please feel free to contact Selectors® Partner Lars Mikkelsen at 2219 4930 or Selectors® on 7210 0030.

About Unilabs A/S

Unilabs A/S is part of Unilabs Pharma Solutions, a leading provider of laboratory services and innovative solutions for the pharmaceutical and biotechnology industries. We support drug development through high-quality bioanalytical testing, helping to ensure that new treatments are developed efficiently, accurately, and in compliance with regulatory standards.

Do you thrive in a laboratory environment where high-quality analytical work is at the center of your daily responsibilities?

On behalf of Unilabs Pharma Solutions, we are seeking an experienced Biomedical Laboratory Scientist/ Bioanalyst to join a highly skilled bioanalytical team in a commercial laboratory providing solutions for the pharmaceutical industry. This role is ideal for a laboratory professional who enjoys performing analytical testing in a regulated pharmaceutical environment while contributing to method improvements, validation activities, and the maintenance of quality standards.

About the Role

The primary focus of this position is the execution of bioanalytical testing supporting pharmaceutical and biotechnology clients throughout drug development programs. You will be responsible for generating high-quality analytical data while ensuring full compliance with applicable regulatory requirements and quality systems.

You will join a collaborative laboratory team where analytical excellence, scientific rigor, and meticulous documentation are essential to success.

Analytical Testing (Primary Focus)

• Perform routine and non-routine bioanalytical testing according to approved methods, SOPs, and study protocols.

• Execute ELISA-based assays and other bioanalytical methods with a high degree of accuracy and consistency.

• Ensure timely delivery of analytical results while maintaining the highest quality standards.

• Review analytical data and documentation for completeness, accuracy, and compliance.

• Perform sample receipt, registration, processing, and analysis activities.

Key Responsibilities

• Maintain, calibrate, troubleshoot, and verify the performance of laboratory equipment, while supporting efficient laboratory workflows and ensuring laboratories remain inspection-ready.

• Participate in method development, optimization, validation, transfer, and continuous improvement of analytical methods and laboratory processes.

• Contribute to the qualification, implementation, and ongoing operation of laboratory equipment, technologies, assays, and designated operational areas.

• Perform all activities in compliance with GxP principles, including GCP, GCLP, GMP, ISO 15189, and pharmaceutical industry standards.

• Maintain accurate, complete, and traceable laboratory documentation, including support for SOP development and revision.

• Support deviation investigations, change controls, CAPAs, audit readiness activities, and participate in regulatory inspections and client audits as required.

• Support the training and qualification of laboratory colleagues and contribute to knowledge sharing across the team.

Who we Are Looking For

We are seeking a hands-on laboratory professional with a strong analytical mindset and experience working within a regulated pharmaceutical or biotech environment.

Qualifications

• Degree as a Biomedical Laboratory Scientist, Laboratory Technologist, Research Laboratory Technician, or equivalent scientific qualification.

• Minimum 2-5 years of experience in the pharmaceutical, biotechnology, CRO, or regulated laboratory industry.

• Practical experience performing bioanalytical testing in a GxP-regulated environment.

• Hands-on experience with ELISA assays is required.

• Strong understanding of laboratory documentation practices, data integrity, and compliance requirements.

• Experience following and working according to SOPs, validation protocols, and quality management systems.

• Fluent in Danish and English, both written and spoken.

To succeed in this role, you are:

• Detail-oriented and quality-focused.

• Comfortable performing repetitive analytical work while maintaining accuracy and consistency.

• Structured and disciplined in your documentation practices.

• Proactive and able to work independently within established procedures.

• A collaborative team player who enjoys working in an international laboratory environment.

What Unilabs Offers

An exciting opportunity to work on pharmaceutical development projects with direct impact on patient care.

A modern laboratory environment in central Copenhagen.

Strong focus on scientific development and professional growth.

A collaborative team culture with experienced colleagues and a high level of technical expertise.

The opportunity to work with advanced bioanalytical methods in a regulated setting.

This role will particularly suit candidates who enjoy spending the majority of their time conducting laboratory analyses and generating high-quality data, while also contributing to validation, compliance, documentation, and continuous improvement activities.

Søg jobbet

Har ovenstående fanget din interesse, søger du stillingen ved at vedhæfte et opdateret cv og en motiveret ansøgning. Du kan også skrive en kort tekst om dig selv i ansøgningsteksten ovenfor. Temp-Team A/S varetager denne rekruttering og al henvendelse skal gå gennem Temp-Team.

Grundet GDPR modtager vi ikke cv og ansøgning via e-mail.

Temp-Team

Temp-Team A/S er et landsdækkende rekrutterings- og vikarbureau med lokale afdelinger i Danmark. Vi har 45 års erfaring inden for bemandingsløsninger og dækker et bredt udsnit af brancher. Vi yder altid en service af høj kvalitet og har tæt, personlig kontakt til både vores kandidater og kunder.

Vi er en del af JuhlerGroup – en international koncern.

About us:

Founded in Copenhagen, Denmark, in 2014, Templafy’s success is built by our 60+ employee nationalities found at offices around the world. We believe that when people feel valued, heard, and empowered, they perform at their best—creating a win for all. Our unique product and dedication to innovation and excellence have raised over $200 million in funding from top investors like Insight Venture Partners, Seed Capital, Dawn Capital, Damgaard Company and Golub Capital.

The team:

Our Revenue Operations team plays a central role in enabling Sales and Customer Success to perform at their best. We own the systems, data, and processes that drive forecasting accuracy, pipeline visibility, and commercial performance.

You will join an international team with colleagues based in Copenhagen and New York, as well as a manager based in Amsterdam.

About the Role

We’re looking for a detail-oriented and analytical student assistant to support our Revenue Operations team. This role is ideal for someone interested in gaining hands-on experience in commercial analytics in SaaS context. This is also a great opportunity to gain more exposure to core GTM systems (Salesforce, Gong, Clay), compensation processes and be able to contribute to commercial initiatives.

Key Responsibilities

Some of the key responsibilities will be to support reporting, systems hygiene, process documentation, and operational projects that directly impact sales and customer success performance. Specifically:

• Build dashboards and ad-hoc analyses as needed

• Support Salesforce data hygiene and reporting accuracy

• Assist with pipeline reporting and forecast preparation

• Help document and improve GTM workflows and processes

• Conduct data audits and identify inconsistencies

• Support compensation tracking and basic commission reporting

• Assist with system testing, automation validation, and QA

What We’re Looking For

• Currently enrolled in a Bachelor’s or Master’s program (Business, Economics, Data, Engineering, or similar)

• Good analytical mindset and comfortable working with data

• Skills working with Excel

• Experience with BI tools (Power BI)

• Detail-oriented and structured, who enjoys improving processes

• Interest in SaaS, Sales, GTM strategy, or operations

Nice to Have:

• Basic Salesforce knowledge

• SQL familiarity

What You’ll Gain

• Exposure to core GTM systems (Salesforce, Gong, Clay)

• Practical experience in SaaS revenue operations

• Insight into forecasting, pipeline management, and compensation processes

• Opportunity to contribute to meaningful commercial initiatives

Employee Benefits:

• Company lunch contribution

• Centrally located office – easy access to public transportation

• Company events and team activities

• Classpass Subscription

• Calm App Subscription

At Templafy, we’re all about building an inclusive culture where talented people come together to spark creativity in a dynamic, collaborative space. Strong relationships and teamwork are at the core of everything we do, and with our flat structure, everyone’s ideas count regardless of your role or experience.

We’re big on social events that foster connection and build a diverse, empowering community. From celebrating milestones to participating in employee resource groups or eating lunch together, we create space for meaningful team bonding.

Our mission goes beyond just building a product; we’re shaping the future, and we’d love for you to be a part of this epic journey with us.

Templafy is a workplace of belongingness. To us this means that you have a voice, you dare to speak up, and your voice is heard. We focus on offering an environment that allows all employees to feel that they belong regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, gender, gender identity, genetic information, parental or pregnancy status, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, or other status.

Are you energized by connecting people, streamlining operations, and creating communications that drive results across a global organization?

As our new Senior Operations & Communication Partner, you will coordinate leadership governance, drive impactful communications, and enable the smooth operation of our Group Environment, Health & Safety (GEHS) function. As a central connector, you will align leaders and teams on strategic priorities and highlight GEHS’ contribution to Grundfos’ success.

What you will be doing

As part of the Group Environment, Health & Safety (GEHS) team, a global team of 30 colleagues, you'll enhance transparency, collaboration, and organizational effectiveness, enabling GEHS leaders to focus on advancing sustainability and safety across Grundfos.

Your main responsibilities include:

• Coordinate GEHS Leadership Team meetings, governance cycles, agendas, materials, and follow-ups to support effective decision-making

• Own and execute GEHS communication activities, including plans, announcements, presentations, and engagement materials aligned with strategic priorities

• Plan and deliver leadership offsites, town halls, workshops, and strategic events

• Ensure consistent GEHS messaging, branding, and storytelling across channels in collaboration with Corporate Communications

• Manage operational processes, tools, templates, and ways of working, identifying opportunities to simplify and scale

• Build strong stakeholder relationships and facilitate collaboration between GEHS and key business functions

What makes you a great fit

Above all, you are a proactive and highly organized communicator who can translate complex topics into clear messages. You combine a strategic perspective with attention to detail and thrive in dynamic, multi-stakeholder environments.

We also imagine that you have:

• Degree in Corporate Communications, Strategic Communication, Business Administration, or a related field

• Experience in communications, business operations, or strategy execution, including supporting leadership teams and governance processes

• Excellent written and verbal English skills, with strong presentation capabilities

• The ability to coordinate multiple stakeholders and priorities while taking a hands-on approach to execution, including updating SharePoint, preparing presentations, and maintaining key documentation.

It is a plus if you also:

• Have experience with AI-driven tools for communication, workflow optimization, or process improvement

• Have a background in Environment, Health & Safety or Sustainability

• Have experience working in a global, matrixed organization

Why you will love working here

We care! Day to day, you can look forward to:

• A working environment built around your needs, with flexible hours, home working opportunities and parental support.

• Annual bonuses, health insurance and a strong focus on well-being activities.

• Three days' additional paid leave for volunteering in your community.

• Access to on-demand training and learning sessions and carefully structured programmes to pursue personal and professional development opportunities.

Are you ready to unlock possibilities at Grundfos? Apply today!

To get to know us better, follow us on LinkedIn or visit grundfos.com

Retire the ERP.

Light exists to replace factory-era ERPs with software that feels alive. Our Smart Financial Platform gives modern, global companies superpowers—automated accounting, real-time reporting, and financial flows that move at the speed of the business.

We build with our customers, ship fast, and obsess over craft. In a short time, Light has gone from idea to the operating core for leading companies like Lovable, Legora, and Keyshot. People don't just use Light—they enjoy it.

We're an early team defining a new software category. Think engineers who love debits and credits, designers who care about reconciliation states, and operators who treat finance as a product. If you're excited to modernize how the world runs money—one workflow at a time—you're in the right place.

Backed by world-class investors and advised by industry titans, we're building category-defining products with the freedom to ship ambitiously and own outcomes. Come help us make Light the global default for next-gen finance.

This Integrations Engineer role

Light is only as powerful as the systems it connects to. Money doesn't move because we say so—it moves because we speak the language of the bank, the e-invoicing network, and the planning tool on the other side, correctly, every time, for every customer entity. This role owns that layer: the interaction surface between Light and the rest of the financial world.

You'll build and operate the integrations that let Light plug into multi-tenant banking APIs (J.P. Morgan, HSBC, and peers), global e-invoicing networks, and tax platforms and more. This is backend-heavy, data-integrity-critical work where a dropped message or a silent reconciliation mismatch is not an acceptable outcome. You'll design the abstractions that turn a dozen incompatible partner APIs into one coherent internal model, and you'll keep those abstractions honest as partners change their specs underneath you.

What you'll work on:

• 
Bank connectivity. Build against corporate banking and payments APIs—account information, payment initiation, status reporting, FX—across providers like J.P. Morgan Payments and HSBC. Handle the realities of bank integrations: certificate-based and mTLS auth, OAuth flows, ISO 20022 (pain/pacs/camt) and legacy MT formats, sandbox-to-production parity, and rate limits that assume you're a bank, not a startup.

• 
Multi-tenancy done right. Our customers are many legal entities operating in many countries. You'll design integrations where credentials, configuration, and data are isolated per tenant, where onboarding a new entity is a workflow rather than a code change, and where one customer's failure never leaks into another's.

• 
Global e-invoicing. Connect Light to e-invoicing networks and country-specific mandates (Peppol and the growing set of national clearance and reporting regimes). Map between formats, manage compliance-driven edge cases, and keep delivery auditable.

• 
Tax platforms for statutory filing, US sales tax and much more.

• 
Reliability and reconciliation. Idempotency, retries, webhook and polling strategies, dead-letter handling, and end-to-end reconciliation so that what we think happened and what actually happened always agree.

Your qualifications

4-6 years of experience ideally, plus…

You build things. Not prototypes, not demos. Working software in production, doing something real for real users. This is the non-negotiable.

You've built integrations against unforgiving external systems. APIs you don't control, that fail in ways the docs don't mention, where correctness is contractual. You know how to defend a system against a partner that returns a 200 with an error in the body.

You know banking and payments APIs. Direct, hands-on experience with corporate banking, treasury, or payments APIs is what sets the strongest candidates apart. Experience integrating J.P. Morgan or HSBC specifically—their developer platforms, auth models, and payment and reporting APIs—is highly valuable and a genuine differentiator for this role. Familiarity with ISO 20022, SWIFT, virtual accounts, or open banking is a strong signal.

You are excited about AI. You use AI tooling efficiently to improve your work. At Light, a lot of code is written with AI, which means the hard part is increasingly the thinking: deciding what to build, reviewing what comes back, and catching where the model is confidently wrong. You know when AI speeds you up, when it's likely to mislead you, and how to lean on it while staying fully responsible for what ships.

You're comfortable across the stack. You don't need to be a specialist in everything, but you can't have a lane you refuse to leave. Our stack is Kotlin and React, and this role leans backend. If you're strong on the backend and curious about the rest, that works.

You care about data integrity. You think about the person on the other end and the money moving between them. You notice when a flow is correct but fragile, and you act on it.

You ship early and often. Small batches. Learn. Go again. You'd rather put something real in front of a customer than spend another week perfecting it in isolation.

Bonus points

• 
Experience in fintech or systems where data integrity is non-negotiable

• 
Familiarity with accounting concepts: debits, credits, reconciliation

• 
Experience with e-invoicing standards or country-specific compliance regimes

• 
Background in high-growth startups where everything was still being figured out

Our Tech Stack

We build on AWS, with a Kotlin backend, a React frontend, and infrastructure managed in Terraform. It's a real production system that global finance teams depend on every day. The integration layer you'll own sits squarely in the Kotlin backend, talking to a long list of external partners. You don't need to have used every piece of it. You do need to be comfortable in this kind of environment: real scale, real customers, real stakes.

The good stuff

In addition to being part of a great team and working in a really fun and innovative environment, we offer:

• 
A competitive salary + potential stock options

• 
25 days of annual leave + public holidays in the country where you are based

• 
Regular socials and company off-sites

• 
A huge opportunity for career growth as you'll help shape a market-defining product

The famous last words

Working at Light means you're embarking on an exciting journey to reshape the future of multinational financial operations. Our cheat-code is that we've built something like this before—and are now doing it again, only better. Our goal is to make global finance effortless and empower companies to make informed decisions.

Join the rocket ship while it's taking off.

Working at

Light

Light is the new way to run multinational finances for modern technology companies. Run AR, AP, expenses, bookkeeping, and financial reporting automatically across all your entities — without the chaos of multiple systems. Crafted and built by the designers and engineers behind world-class companies like Spotify, X, AWS, Klarna, Google and Shopify, we empower multinational finances with a joyful user experience like no other.

Institut for Retsmedicin på Aarhus Universitets sundhedsvidenskabelige fakultet søger en klinisk adjunkt i retsmedicin pr. 1. januar 2027 eller snarest muligt derefter. Stillingen er en tidsbegrænset honorarstilling, som udløber når hoveduddannelsesforløbet til speciallæge i retsmedicin afsluttes.

Som klinisk adjunkt ved Institut for Retsmedicin bliver du en del af en arbejdsplads med dedikerede og specialiserede medarbejdere. Alle deler et mål om at forebygge og opklare kriminalitet, ulykker, for tidlig død og selvmord gennem forskning, undervisning og retsmedicinske undersøgelser. Instituttet hører under det sundhedsvidenskabelige fakultet Health på Aarhus Universitet og beskæftiger 70 medarbejdere fordelt på to afdelinger, der leverer uvildig og evidensbaseret myndighedsbetjening for politiet. Afdeling for Retskemi identificerer og bestemmer renheden af euforiserende stoffer og lægemidler i biologisk materiale og i genstande beslaglagt af politiet. Afdeling for Retspatologi foretager retslægelige obduktioner, findestedsundersøgelser og kliniske retsmedicinske undersøgelser. Begge afdelinger er enten akkrediteret efter kvalitetsstandarderne ISO 17025 eller ISO 17020. Derudover har instituttet tre forskningsenheder, der fokuserer på bioanalytisk kemi, retsmedicinsk billeddiagnostik og klinisk retsmedicin. De ansatte bevæger sig i krydsfeltet mellem myndighedsbetjeningen og grund- og anvendt forskning, og instituttet har et skrapt fokus på det gode arbejdsmiljø, som er en forudsætning for høj kvalitet i løsningen af opgaver på alle niveauer. Du kan læse mere om instituttet her og om fakultetet her.

Dine arbejdsopgaver
Som klinisk adjunkt i retsmedicin bidrager du til udvikling af instituttets forsknings- og undervisningsmiljø, hvor du gennemfører undervisning inden for instituttets undervisningsområder. I din undervisning sikrer du en høj faglig og didaktisk standard.

Dine opgaver vil primært bestå af:

• Forskningsopgaver
• Forberedelse af og gennemførelse af undervisning
• Eksamensforpligtigelse, herunder mundtlige eksaminationer
• I begrænset omfang vejledning af bachelor- og kandidatstuderende
• Øvrige opgaver
Du refererer til institutleder Christian Lindholst.

Ansættelse som klinisk adjunkt kræver samtidigt ansættelse i et hoveduddannelsesforløb til speciallæge inden for retsmedicin.

Dine kompetencer
Du har en lægevidenskabelig kandidateksamen og erfaring inden for det retsmedicinske fagområde. Du har videnskabelige kvalifikationer på ph.d.-niveau og erfaring med forskningsvejledning på universitetsniveau. Du vil varetage undervisning af studerende i kliniske fag og evner at opbygge tillidsfulde relationer til både studerende, kolleger og samarbejdspartnere. Som underviser formidler du den nyeste og relevante viden engageret, klart og tydeligt.

Som person har du gode samarbejdsevner, er imødekommende og evner at bidrage til et godt arbejdsmiljø.

Vi forventer du taler og skriver flydende engelsk.

For at kunne blive bedømt kvalificeret som klinisk adjunkt, skal du opfylde disse faglige kriterier.

For at komme i betragtning til stillingen skal ansøger opfylde de formelle krav til videnskabelige ansættelser ved Aarhus Universitet og indsende alt relevant ansøgningsmateriale inden ansøgningsfristen. Ansøgninger, der er væsentligt mangelfulde, vil ikke indgå i den videre vurdering.

Du vil indgå i den retsmedicinske vagtordning.

Indhentelse af en tilfredsstillende straffeattest og børneattest er en forudsætning for ansættelse i stillingen. 

Spørgsmål til stillingen
Har du spørgsmål til stillingen, er du velkommen til at kontakte institutleder, Christian Lindholst tlf.: +45 8716 7500.

Arbejdsstedet er Institut for Retsmedicin, Palle Juul-Jensens Boulevard 43, 8200 Aarhus N, Danmark.

Vi forventer at afholde samtaler i december 2026. 

Ansættelsesgrundlag
• Kvalifikationskrav og stillingsindhold er yderligere beskrevet i stillingsstrukturen for videnskabeligt personale ved universiteter.
• Ansættelse som klinisk adjunkt forudsætter, at vedkommende er erklæret kvalificeret hertil af et bedømmelsesudvalg. 
• Det er en forudsætning, at den pågældende har påbegyndt et hoveduddannelsesforløb til speciallæge.
• Ansættelse og aflønning sker i henhold til Cirkulære om aftale om kliniske adjunkter ved universiteter under Uddannelses- og Forskningsministeriet.
Ansøgning
Din ansøgning skal indeholde følgende:

• Ansøgning
• Curriculum Vitae
• Eksamensbevis
• Skabelon til ansøger - klinisk adjunkt skal udfyldes og uploades under feltet ’Skabelon til ansøger’ 
• Publikationsliste
• Undervisningsportfolio. Vi henviser til Vejledning til anvendelse af undervisningsportfolio
• 3 af de for stillingen mest relevante publikationer kan medsendes (valgfrit)
• Forskningsplan, som fremgår af 'Skabelon til ansøger – klinisk adjunkt', kan også medsendes separat (valgfrit)
• Medforfattererklæring kan medsendes (valgfrit)
• Referencer/anbefalinger kan uploades særskilt i e-rekrutteringssystemet (valgfrit)
Vi henviser til fakultetets Vejledning for ansøgere.

Aarhus Universitet vil være en attraktiv og inspirerende arbejdsplads for alle og ønsker en kultur, hvor hver enkelt kan udfolde og udvikle sig. Vi ser ligestilling og diversitet som en styrke og opfordrer derfor alle interesserede til at ansøge.

Ansøgning sendes via Aarhus Universitets rekrutteringssystem, som kan tilgås under stillingsopslaget på Aarhus Universitets hjemmeside.

jobs.occupation: 14 postdoctoral fellowships to the BRIDGE – Translational Excellence Programme
jobs.description:
BRIDGE – Translational Excellence Programme
 The BRIDGE – Translational Excellence Programme at the University of Copenhagen is seeking 14 highly motivated and dynamic postdoc fellows to commence the BRIDGE – Translational Excellence Programme on 1 September 2027.

  The BRIDGE – Translational Excellence Programme is financed by the Novo Nordisk Foundation with the ambition to train fellows in translational medicine, mentored by fully committed and top-level professionals in basic biomedical research, a clinical environment and the life science industry. The programme constitutes a clear career path for candidates whose ambition is to bridge the gap between research, patient care and the life science industry and for those wishing to become pioneering leaders in the field of translational medicine.

  The BRIDGE – Translational Excellence Programme expects to appoint 7 fellows with an MD background and 7 fellows with an MSc background. The fellow will be appointed in the lab of the basic mentor either at the Faculty of Health and Medical Sciences (SUND) or the Faculty of SCIENCE (SCIENCE), UCPH.

  Application deadline is 9 February 2027, at 23:59 CET. Appointed fellows are expected to participate in a two-day Boot Camp on 9-10 September 2027. Mentors are expected to participate on 9 September 2027.

  Translational research project
 Your research project must cover the early translational stages T₀ (Disease modelling, Omics studies, Basic Research) -T₁ (Biomarker discovery, Target development, Preclinical development) and should bridge a basic biomedical research environment and a clinical research environment, making the research project interdisciplinary in its nature. The project may also cover early T₂ (First in human, phase 1 clinical trials, phase 2 clinical trials, phase 2b clinical trials), but this is not a requirement. 

  Your project must be at the postdoctoral level, should address a relevant medical challenge and should be ambitious yet feasible within the timeframe of two years. Your research project must be developed in collaboration with your Mentor Team and is an important part of the recruitment process to become a BRIDGE Fellow.

  Appointed fellows spend 80% of their time on individual translational research projects mentored by a Mentor Team consisting of a basic biomedical scientist from a SUND or SCIENCE Department or Centre, and a clinical scientist from a hospital in the Capital Region of Denmark or Region Zealand and/or from the life science industry. Additional mentors from other departments and universities in Denmark are encouraged if relevant.

  Academic Curriculum
 The BRIDGE – Translational Excellence Programme provides fellows with the ability to translate insights from basic research into the clinical sciences and/or the life science industry, and vice versa, and the competences to manage essential collaboration between disciplines.

  A uniquely developed 55 days Academic Curriculum has been designed by top-professional experts and figures as a mandatory, integral, and important part of the BRIDGE programme. 

  The Academic Curriculum covers the translational stages T₀ (Population/clinic to lab feedback, disease modelling -omic studies, basic research), T₁ (Biomarker discovery, target development, pre-clinical development) and border to early T₂ (First in human, phase 1 clinical trials, phase 2 clinical trials, phase 2b clinical trials). 

  In addition, courses also include generic skills such as research management, ethics, research communication and successful grant writing. The Academic Curriculum and additional events such as the Boot Camp, Academic Afternoons, Alumni Event comprise 20% of fellows’ time. The fellows should therefore not be imposed teaching obligations during their fellowship.

  Eligibility
 Future BRIDGE Fellows must hold one of the following: 

   	
• An MD and a PhD degree or equivalent (proof of an appointment that requires doctoral equivalency). Specialist training is no hindrance to apply, and medical training is appreciated.    	
• An MSc and a PhD degree or equivalent (BSc integrated PhD) within a relevant discipline such as veterinary science, biology, biochemistry, molecular biology, bioinformatics, pharmacy, dentistry, or medical engineering.   The following requirements must also be met:

  The PhD degree should have been obtained no more than eight years before the application deadline. Any documented periods of leave will be accepted as extensions of this time limit (maternity leave, paternity leave, family care leave, illness, military service, etc.).

  As a current PhD student, you may apply if you and your supervisor expect your thesis to be submitted and defended prior to project commencement on 1 September 2027.  You must attach a declaration from your supervisor stating that your thesis will be submitted and defended prior to project commencement on 1 September 2027.

  In Denmark, you can hold postdoc positions for no more than a total of four years at one university. Accordingly, no more than two years of postdoc experience based at one of the departments at UCPH prior to programme enrolment is allowed. Any documented periods of leave will be accepted as extensions of this time limit (parental leave, family care leave, illness, military service, etc.). Please find more information about the 'four-year rule' for postdocs (Danish legislation) under 'Eligibility and conditions' and about the applicable governmental jurisdiction here.

  Mentor Teams
 The applicant must apply for the programme in cooperation with a Mentor Team consisting of a minimum of two mentors.

  A Mentor Team requires a mentor representing 1) the basic biomedical science from the Faculty of Health and Medical Sciences (SUND) or the Faculty of SCIENCE (SCIENCE), UCPH, and 2) clinical science from the Capital Region of Denmark or Region Zealand and/or 3) the life science industry environment in Denmark. A life science industry mentor is highly encouraged to enter the Mentor Team.

  We also encourage larger mentor teams with additional mentors from Technical University of Denmark (DTU), or other universities or research institutions, if relevant. 

  Incorporating a mentor from SUND or SCIENCE, UCPH, into the Mentor Team is mandatory. If a mentor acts as a third, fourth or fifth mentor – accompanying a basic and clinical mentor – that mentor may reside outside Denmark.

  NOTE: One can only be a mentor for maximum two candidates for each call. 

  Qualifications
 As a BRIDGE fellow, you are highly motivated to participate in the Academic Curriculum, to be mentored by senior researchers, network and cooperate with other BRIDGE Fellows and you see yourself as an ambitious scientist who will work on bridging the gaps between research, medical treatment and/or the life science industry.

  We expect BRIDGE Fellows to be scientifically independent, showing a high degree of academic maturity. This means that they will have:

   	
• An enthusiastic interest in a translational research project co-designed with a Mentor Team and be a good match with a committed Mentor Team 	
• A strong CV, having published peer reviewed original manuscripts in high-quality journals with minimum one first author paper and presented at international conferences 	
• The ability to manage one’s own academic research and associated activities 	
• Experience with project management 	
• Experience with research supervision of more junior researchers (pre-graduate or PhD students) or clinicians  	
• Excellent interpersonal skills and leadership, including the ability to communicate research ideas and results in a clear and logical way and the ability to interact with peers and the broader research community confidently and effectively   How to apply
 As a BRIDGE fellow, you will be working on a translational research project co-designed with a Mentor Team. As such, the first step in the application process is to connect with a Mentor Team.

  If you are not already in contact with an eligible Mentor Team, we recommend that you:

   	
• Contact a (i) basic biomedical researcher from SUND or SCIENCE, UCPH, a (ii) clinical scientist from a hospital in the Capital Region of Denmark or Region Zealand and/or (ii) a scientist from the life science industry who fits your research interests and fulfil the programme requirements for Mentor Teams. We recommend that you have the Mentor Team preapproved in due time before application deadline 9 February 2027 by sending a request to BRIDGE: bridge@sund.ku.dk 	
• Alternatively, browse through the list of submitted project synopses (Open Mentor Teams) and find a Mentor Team that fits your research interests. Contact the suitable Mentor Team to explore the possibility of collaborating on a BRIDGE application. The list will be published on the BRIDGE website on 14 December 2026.   If you are an applicant without ties to the Faculty or hospitals in either of the two regions, please read more about our suggestions on how to proceed here.

  If you are in contact with a Mentor Team, we recommend that you:

   	
• Have the Mentor Team constellation preapproved in due time before the call closure by sending a request to BRIDGE: bridge@sund.ku.dk.   Read more about how to become a fellow.

   Application material

   	
• Part 1: Project description (must be co-designed by the applicant and Mentor Team) 	
• Part 2: Project abstract and CV (must be composed by the applicant independently) 	
• Part 3: Supplementary documents    Applications (Part 1, Part 2, and Part 3) must be submitted online through the link on the website no later than 9 February 2027, 23:59 CET. A cover letter is not needed, and there is no need for entering the application in NORMA. 

  Please find the requirements for the application and download the new and updated application templates.

  We reserve the right to disregard material received after the application deadline along with applications and application material that do not comply with the above-mentioned criteria. 

  Recruitment procedure  
 The received applications will be shortlisted and assessed according to the Ministry Order on the Appointment of Academic Staff at Universities 2012 and the University of Copenhagen’s guidelines 2013.  

  Upon the application deadline, the authorised recruitment manager will select applicants for assessment based on the advice of the Appointment Committee.

  All applicants will be notified on whether their application has been passed for assessment. The Assessment Committee will do a non-prioritised assessment based on the applicant’s academic qualifications and on the match between the fellow and the translational research project. All applicants will have the opportunity to comment on the part of the assessment that relates to the applicant themselves (Part 2).

  Please find more information on the recruitment process for scientific personnel at the University of Copenhagen.

  Appointment interviews
 Following the completion of the assessments, a subset of candidates will be invited for a physical appointment interview with the Appointment Committee. The BRIDGE Programme will reimburse travel and accommodation expenses for invited applicants.

  The interviews are scheduled to take place 11-13 May 2027. Please note that Mentor Teams will need to be present online for a short introduction of the Mentor Team at this interview.

  Terms of employment
 The employment as Postdoc is fulltime (37 hours per week) and for two years. The start date is on 1 September 2027.

  Salary, pension, and terms of employment will be in accordance with the collective agreement between AC (Danish Confederation of Professional Associations) and the Ministry of Finance. 

  The position is covered by the “Memorandum on Job Structure for Academic Staff at the Universities” of 2025.

  Financial composition of the fellowships
 The financing of running costs for the individual research projects will be covered by the hosting environments. Each fellow will in addition receive an annual sum of DKK 40,000 during their two-year employment to cover costs for PC, travel, language courses, conference and workshop participation and other relevant activities outside the programme.

  Successful fellowship recipients will be enrolled in the BRIDGE – Translational Excellence Programme and employed at the Faculty of Health and Medical Sciences at UCPH. Upon fulfilment of course participation and the individual research projects, fellows will be awarded a Certificate of Excellence.

  For more information about the BRIDGE - Translational Excellence Programme  
 Please visit www.bridge.ku.dk and/or contact Programme Manager Kathrine Bjerregaard Nielsen on bridge@sund.ku.dk or telephone +45 35 32 98 71.

  The University of Copenhagen wishes to reflect the diversity of society and welcomes applications from all qualified candidates regardless of personal background.

jobs.occupation: PhD scholarship in small-scale coastal fishing methods - DTU Aqua
jobs.description:
We invite applications for a PhD position focused on small-scale coastal fishing methods. The successful candidate will contribute to research supporting the development of low impact sustainable small-scale fisheries.

You will join the Section for Fisheries Technology at DTU Aqua in Hirtshals. The section has 25 employees and focuses on research and development of fishing gears and methods that can support economic and environmental sustainability in the fishing sector.

We offer a rewarding and challenging job in a cross-disciplinary research team in an international environment where we strive for academic excellence and impact.

Setnets and hook-based methods are among the most widely used small-scale coastal fishing methods. They are simple, relatively inexpensive, and highly versatile across target species, habitats, and fishing vessels. Within the European Union, the small-scale coastal fleet comprises 77% of all active fishing vessels while accounting for 16.6% of the total landed value. 

This PhD scholarship will specifically address catch efficiency, selectivity and capture patterns for these fishing methods through experimental work at sea and laboratory experiments. Further it will investigate the feasibility of multi-gear use in the small-scale coastal fishing fleet to strengthen economic viability over seasons.

A significant part of the research and development activities is to be carried out in collaboration with the fishing and fishing gear industries. 

Key Responsibilities

• 
Plan and conduct gear trials on small-scale fishing vessels.

• 
Collect, analyse and interpret results from scientific gear trials.

• 
Publish research findings in high-impact journals and present at international conferences.

Qualifications and requirements

• 
A two-year master's degree (120 ECTS points) in Marine Science or Engineering.

• 
A strong interest and experience in fishing gears and methods.

• 
Prior knowledge and experience with small scale coastal fishery.

• 
Experience in collecting scientific data on small-scale fishing vessels.

• 
Ability to work independently on small fishing vessels.

• 
Experience in analyzing scientific data preferably including data from fisheries.

• 
Experience with publishing in peer reviewed scientific journals is an advantage.

• 
Fluent in a Scandinavian language is required due to extensive industry collaboration.

• 
Ability to work independently as well as in an interdisciplinary team.

• 
Excellent communication skills in English (written and spoken).

You must have a two-year master's degree (120 ECTS points) or a similar degree with an academic level equivalent to a two-year master's degree.

Approval and Enrolment 
The scholarship for the PhD degree is subject to academic approval, and the candidate will be enrolled in one of the general degree programmes at DTU. For information about our enrolment requirements and the general planning of the PhD study programme, please see DTU's rules for the PhD education. 

We offer
DTU is a leading technical university globally recognized for the excellence of its research, education, innovation and scientific advice. We offer a rewarding and challenging job in an international environment. We strive for academic excellence in an environment characterized by collegial respect and academic freedom tempered by responsibility.

Salary and appointment terms
The appointment will be based on the collective agreement with the Danish Confederation of Professional Associations. Please see DTU’s salary structure for scientific staff: www.inside.dtu.dk/en/human-resources/during-employment/salary/salary-structures

Starting date is February1st 2027 (or according to mutual agreement). The position is a full-time position. The period of employment is 3 years.

You can read more about career paths at DTU here.

Further information 
Further information may be obtained from Head of Section for Fisheries Technology, Jordan Feekings, +45 24895821; email: jpfe@aqua.dtu.dk

You can read more about the section here.

If you are applying from abroad, you may find useful information on working in Denmark and at DTU at DTU – Moving to Denmark. Furthermore, you have the option of joining our monthly free seminar “PhD relocation to Denmark and startup “Zoom” seminar” for all questions regarding the practical matters of moving to Denmark and working as a PhD at DTU. 

Application procedure 
Your complete online application must be submitted no later than 1 November 2026 (23:59 Danish time). 

Applications must be submitted as one PDF file containing all materials to be given consideration. To apply, please open the link "Apply now", fill out the online application form, and attach all your materials in English in one PDF file. The file must include:

• 
A letter motivating the application (cover letter)

• 
Curriculum vitae

• 
Grade transcripts and BSc/MSc diploma (in English) including official description of grading scale

You may apply prior to obtaining your master's degree but cannot begin before having received it. 

Applications received after the deadline will not be considered.

All interested candidates irrespective of age, gender, disability, race, religion or ethnic background are encouraged to apply. As DTU works with research in critical technology, which is subject to special rules for security and export control, open-source background checks may be conducted on qualified candidates for the position.

About DTU Aqua
DTU Aqua – National Institute of Aquatic Resources – works for well-functioning oceans, rivers, and lakes where biodiversity can thrive. Our research, advisory service, and education contribute to the development of a sustainable blue bioeconomy, robust aquatic ecosystems, and reduced effects of climate change. We have a large national and international network and cooperate with research partners, public authorities, industry, and NGOs. We have state-of-the-art research facilities and Denmark’s only ocean- and arctic-going research vessel. The Institute has about 400 employees, one-half being scientific staff, including about 45 PhD students. About 40 nationalities are represented at the institute, and we support an equal gender distribution. We are located in Lyngby, Hirtshals, Nykøbing Mors, and Silkeborg and have regular activities in Greenland. Learn more on aqua.dtu.dk

DTU – For the benefit of society since 1829
DTU is one of Europe's leading elite technical universities. Through research and education at an international top level, we create solutions to the major societal challenges of our time and help secure Europe's global leadership in sustainable technological development. Since Hans Christian Ørsted founded DTU almost 200 years ago, our mission has remained the same: We develop and create value through the natural and technical sciences for the benefit of society. DTU has 13,800 students, 1,600 PhD students, and 6,500 employees. We work in an international environment and have an inclusive, stimulating, and informal work culture. DTU has campuses in all parts of Denmark and in Greenland and collaborates with the best universities around the world.
